title: Guest Damage Claim Desk
oneLiner: Short-term rental managers turn messy cleaner photos, invoices, and platform replies into a calm damage-claim timeline.

sourceSignals.title: Short-term rental hosts report damage-claim admin work not reimbursed and listings restricted after claims
Travelers still struggle with cancelled-flight refund evidence and escalation scripts

stitchPrompt: Create a polished hospitality claim workspace called “Guest Damage Claim Desk” for short-term rental managers. Show a property header, room-by-room photo evidence, cleaner notes, invoices, platform claim status, excluded-cost warnings, and a next booking recovery checklist. Design direction: use the premium-editorial profile with warm charcoal/stone tones, refined spacing, curated evidence cards, and one quiet CTA color.
